name: Tailgate Weekend Setup
why: Shelter, cold food, seats and light for an SUV weekend: one order, everything fits the cargo area.

name: Truck Bed Camping Setup
why: Tent + matching 6-6.5 ft mattress + side awning for full-size standard-bed pickups.

name: Shade Basecamp Setup
why: Car-side shade, a bug-free screen room, two chairs and the wagon to haul it.

name: Couple's Bell Tent Setup
why: Canvas tent, a raised two-person bed and two rocking recliners: glamping without the hotel price.

name: Camp Kitchen Setup
why: Cook station, campfire grill, packed bins and a work light.

name: Campsite Privacy Setup
why: Private changing/shower room, light inside it, bins for toiletries and wet gear.

name: Family Campground Setup
why: Big SUV tent, a two-person cot, wagon, two oversized chairs and a fire grill.

name: Off-Grid Power & Cooling Setup
why: Power station + solar panel + 20 L fridge: cold food for a weekend without hookups.
